new_repository_result: The JANUS chain now automatically discovers, from raw tagged factors, a restricted acyclic portfolio decomposition into native C039 affine and C039.1 single-head Horn regions, derives a verified variable vtree witness, and emits replayable SAT/UNSAT dynamic-programming messages while charging all interface tables and discovery work.
claim_boundary: No source or C040 artifact proves polynomial discovery or composition beyond acyclic module graphs with logarithmic per-module interfaces, nor a universal standard-vtree width bound.
